definitions.definition: ترکیبی از حقوق و وظایف مدنی و سیاسی به مثابه نوعی پایگاه اجتماعی که به تمامی اعضای جامعه اعطا شده و افراد را فارغ از تعلقات طبقاتی، قومی، نژادی، مذهبی و اقتصادی یکسان و برابر فرض می‌کند.

must_not_be_lost: The connection between human world-alienation and Arendtian citizenship as a normative alternative.
output.segment_function: The block introduces key theoretical figures like Herbert Marcuse, Erich Fromm, and Hannah Arendt to discuss human alienation (world-alienation) and citizenship, framing Arendt's concept of citizenship as a normative alternative to modern alienation.
unresolved_context: Specific details regarding the exact mechanisms of Arendt's action and natality are not fully elaborated in this introductory block beyond the general invocation of citizenship as an alternative to world-alienation.
